turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Well, what finally got me in here is that... over these past few months, my mind just keeps jumping around. It's like every time the CB radio chirps in the cab, or I pass a fuel price sign, or even if I just get a new idea in my head, I get completely sidetracked. 

I'm starting to miss details that I normally never miss on the job. Things like overlooking a client’s delivery note, or totally forgetting who I promised to call back. I just can't seem to keep my focus where it needs to be, so I figured I better come in and talk to somebody about it.
